methodology.sector_neutral_field: sector_adjusted_drawdown_residual_pp = stock drawdown - sector median drawdown
methodology.industry_neutral_field: industry_adjusted_drawdown_residual_pp = stock drawdown - detailed-industry median when n>=5, otherwise sector median
methodology.peer_neutral_field: peer_adjusted_drawdown_residual_pp = stock drawdown - detailed-industry×profit-module median when n>=5, otherwise industry/sector benchmark
